label: healthy
description: F1a precision false positive: the agent re-runs the same test suite with identical args (no `target`, so canonicalization sees an unchanging action) after every fix, and the test count climbs 1 -> 8 passed each time. LoopDetector sees only the repeated (tool, args) pair -- it has no visibility into `result` by design -- and reaches STOP by the 5th repeat even though the agent is making real, verifiable progress. Guards the loop<-progress suppression (LOOP-2 precision issue #113): a repetition that is actually advancing must not be stopped by loop alone.
